required_stages.description: Per output element, fp32 accumulation of the kernel_rows*kernel_cols tap products over the zero-padded neighbourhood (cross-correlation, offsets i - kr//2, j - kc//2), read directly from the flat image inside the launch.
Single rounding of the fp32 accumulator to the input dtype and store into a freshly allocated flat output; one launch, no intermediate, no host padding.

forbidden_substitutions.message: library convolution / FFT filtering replaces the whole computation
im2col/unfold + matmul or host-side padding is a different algorithm family
extra buffer, host padding or kernel flip
host-side transformation of the kernel or image beyond a metadata view

required_evidence.message: tap offsets centred with kernel_rows//2, kernel_cols//2

outputs.aliasing: none; a freshly allocated flat (input_rows*input_cols,) tensor in input's dtype on every call

timing_boundary.notes: The timed run() contains the element-count guard, the output allocation, metadata-only 2-D views and one launch. No host padding, im2col, casts or copies; no state across calls. Per-tap product precision for fp16 is the open review item.
